div.head: VIII Atr 12
div.ab: Sulhælmessan gebireð þæt man gelæste be wite æghwilce geare, þonne XV niht beoð agan ofer eastertid.
Sulhælmessan gebireð þæt man gelæste be wite æghwilce geare, þonne XV niht beoð agan ofer Eastertid.
Plough-alms ought to be rendered every year 15 days after Easter, under pain of incurring the fine.
It is appropriate that plow dues be paid each year fifteen nights after Easter or there will be a penalty.
Pflugalmosen gebührt sich, dass bei Strafe geleistet werde in jedem Jahre, wenn 14 Tage über Ostern vergangen sind.
It is fitting that plough-alms be paid every year, on pain of a fine, when a fortnight has passed after Easter.
